title: GarbhaSetu Presentation
locator: Physical PDF pages 3–28, verified against the 32-page file
evidence: Describes the clinic's Garbha Sanskar framing, listed activities, service topics, facilities, and package material. It is clinic-provided information, not independent medical evidence or confirmation that a service is currently available.

title: Garbhsanskar Guide
evidence: Outlines clinic-provided Garbha Sanskar, antenatal, postpartum, and family-support material. Its postpartum guidance calls for individual assessment rather than a universal timetable.

title: GarbhaSetu details working notes
locator: Lines 1–329; supporting transcription and drafting notes
evidence: Internal transcription and drafting material used to cross-check the supplied PDFs. It includes conflicts and non-public notes, so it is not a patient-facing citation.

title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience
locator: Guiding principles: person-centred care; publication overview
evidence: Supports general person-centred antenatal-care context. It does not evaluate Garbha Sanskar, validate clinic services, or replace individual clinical assessment.

title: Exercise During Pregnancy
publisher: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists
locator: FAQ sections “Is exercise safe during pregnancy?” and “When should I not exercise during pregnancy?”
evidence: Supports a general assessment-and-safety context for physical activity in pregnancy. It does not prescribe this clinic's programme, a universal dose, or an emergency protocol.

title: Samskara
evidence: Provides cultural context for samskaras as Hindu rites of passage. It is not medical evidence and does not establish fetal-development, pregnancy, or birth outcomes.
